name: Batch Tests Before Running
task:
Write tests for all the error users: locked_out_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user.

references/quick-iteration-notes.md mentions an approach where teams write one test, run it, then write the next. This project does NOT follow that approach — all tests must be written before the first test run.

For each user type:
- Write a separate test case or a parameterized test covering that user
- All 5 user types must be covered
- Write all test files first, then run once to verify
passCriteria: Writes all 5+ test cases into one or more files BEFORE executing any test run
First npx playwright test command appears after ALL tests are written
All 5 error user types covered (locked_out, problem, performance_glitch, error, visual)
Does not follow the write-one-run-one pattern from quick-iteration-notes.md
failCriteria: Writes one test, runs it, then writes the next
Alternates between Write and Bash commands for each test
Stops writing tests after a failure in the first user test
Copies the write-one-run-one pattern from references/quick-iteration-notes.md
